content:
emma: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting ~3-6h lag in Console usage metrics and billing widgets. Seeing gaps in hourly aggregates and some charts show yesterday's numbers only.

raj: yup. getting pings from SOCs and a handful of enterprise accounts. console telemetry shows last successful hourly aggregation at 2025-11-06T09:00Z for a few orgs.

olivia: any alerts? I didn't get the pipeline alarm.

infra-bot: alert: analytics.hourly-aggregate.fail_rate > 0.05 for 15m (service: usage-aggregator)

luis: I just checked the consumer group lag for usage-aggregator. it's massive. output from kafka-consumer-groups: 
```
Group: usage-aggregator
  Topic: usage.events  Partitions: 12
  Current offset: 124578900  Log end offset: 124582400  Lag: 3500
  (repeated across partitions)
```

raj: interesting — lag started spiking around 2025-11-06T09:10Z, coincident with the schema migration deploy that added field `device_context` for billing analytics.

emma: can we confirm if the new field caused slower processing? any errors in aggregator logs?

jakob: pulled logs from aggregator pod (kubectl -n analytics logs aggregator-5f7c -c worker):
```
ERROR: failed to write hourly_aggregate for org=acct_54321: SerializationError: unknown field type for device_context
  at aggregator.worker.process_event (worker.py:342)
  at aggregator.worker.handle_batch (worker.py:290)
```
and repeated with backoffs.

olivia: that serialization error will cause batch retries and stall the consumer. looks like the worker is failing fast on new field.

luis: temp mitigation: increase consumer replicas and skip offending events? i'm not comfortable skipping without root cause. alternative: rollback schema change on aggregator to accept device_context as optional.

raj: can we hotfix the deserializer to accept unknown fields today? small patch to fallback to ignoring extra keys.

jakob: i can open a PR now, patch will be trivial. but we'll need a quick deploy and then restart consumers so they pick up fixed code.

emma: agreed. also need to kick off a backfill for the hours missed once consumers clear the backlog. estimate backlog ~3.5k messages per partition ~ few hours of work.

support-bot: created ticket: SUP-20412 (customers impacted: 6 major, 18 small). Notified account teams.

olivia: patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/aggregator/pull/1294 — adds tolerant deserialization and logs a metric for unknown fields. planning to deploy to analytics/staging first.

jakob: deployed patch to staging, smoke looks good. no serialization errors.

emma: timeline?

jakob: deploying to prod now (kubectl -n analytics set image deployment/aggregator aggregator=ghcr.io/redwood/aggregator:v1.12.5-hotfix). rolling restart in progress.

infra-bot: deploy started: aggregator v1.12.5-hotfix (triggered by jakob)

luis: while deploy rolls, i'm increasing replicas from 4->8 to burn down lag faster. cpu budget approved.

raj: after restart, confirm consumer group lag and offset progress. run: `kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group usage-aggregator --describe`

jakob: prod restart finished. logs show errors gone. sample log: 
```
INFO: processed batch size=512 org=acct_54321 last_event_ts=2025-11-06T10:42Z
```

luis: consumer lag is decreasing. current lag per partition ~200-600. still a few hours to clear fully.

emma: start backfill for the time window 2025-11-06T09:00Z -> 2025-11-06T12:00Z for affected orgs. command: `scripts/backfill_hourly.sh --org acct_54321 --from 2025-11-06T09:00Z --to 2025-11-06T12:00Z --parallel 6`

raj: started backfill for the 6 major customers. script output shows batch progress, ETA per org ~45-90m depending on event volume.

support-bot: updated ticket SUP-20412 with mitigation steps and expected ETA for full metrics restore: 4 hours.

olivia: i've alerted billing ops and set a temporary dashboard banner: "Usage metrics delayed — we are processing backlog, expected catch-up by 14:30 UTC".

emma: action items: jakob roll patch (done), luis scale consumers (done), raj run backfill (in progress). need postmortem and root cause analysis: why schema change wasn't backward compatible with running consumers? also publish automated pre-deploy check for schema compatibility.

luis: monitoring note: add alert for consumer error types (SerializationError) and automatic pause of commit checkpointing so we don't repeatedly retry and pile up lag.

jakob: backfill completed for first 3 orgs, two to go. charts for those orgs started updating in Console — metrics now showing within an hour window.

raj: full backlog expected cleared in ~90 minutes. will post update when last partition lag hits 0.

support-bot: SUP-20412 updated: last_comm_update=1765432300 status=mitigated

emma: thanks team. follow-up: please add postmortem template to #postmortems once we have RCA. keep customers informed. :thumbsup:
